shortDescription: Returns the mapping between physical, logical, and virtual devices as facts

options.name: component
options.description: Specifies the type of devices to retrieve information for. C(vscsi) to list virtual SCSI devices. C(npiv) to list NPIV devices. C(net) to list shared Ethernet adapters. C(vnic) to list server virtual NIC adapters. C(ams) to list paging space devices that are used in active memory sharing. C(suspend) to list suspended virtual adapters. C(cluster) to list shared storage pool mappings C(all) to list all devices.

options.name: cpid
options.description: Specifies the client partition ID, in decimal, for which to return device mapping information. This option is only supported on certain VIOS levels.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Specifies the host name or IP address of the VIOS partition.

options.name: physloc
options.description: Specifies the device physical location code of a server virtual adapter. Mutually exclusive with I(vadapter).

options.name: types
options.description: Specifies the type of devices to display. The following types are supported: C(disk) to list physical backing devices. C(lv) to list logical volume backing devices. C(optical) to list optical backing devices. C(tape) to list tape backed devices. C(file) to list file backed devices. C(file_disk) to list file backed disk devices. C(file_opt) to list file backed optical devices. C(cl_disk) to list clustered backing devices. C(usb_disk) to list USB disks.

options.name: vadapter
options.description: Specifies the device name of a server virtual adapter. Mutually exclusive with I(physloc).

options.name: vtd
options.description: Specifies the active memory sharing (AMS) paging device to be displayed.
